name: Nalidixic acid

overview.mechanism: The historical US NegGram label describes nalidixic acid as a quinolone antibacterial.
uses: The 2009 US NegGram label covers urinary tract infections caused by susceptible gram-negative organisms; susceptibility testing is emphasized.

evidence.title: Historical label: kidney and toxicity precautions

paragraphs.text: The 2009 label cautions in renal insufficiency and notes that substantial renal excretion can increase toxicity risk when kidney function is impaired. It contains a renal dose-reduction section using creatinine clearance, not eGFR. No HD, PD or CRRT schedule is inferred here.

sources.citation: FDA. NegGram Caplets (nalidixic acid) US prescribing information, 2009. NDA014214 supplement058. Historical US label; verified 2026-11-25.

draft_notes: Historical label has both contraindication and caution wording for CNS conditions. Contraindication is retained explicitly; no softening or conflict-resolution clinical call added. No renal numeric regimen promoted to current practice.

revision_log.change: New source-linked descriptive literature or historical US-label summary. No inferred dialysis dosing or current Philippine-label claim.
revision_log.approved_by: W. G. M. Rivero, MD (delegated source-verification workflow; executed by Codex, 2026-11-25)

usual_adult_dose.indication: Historical 2009 US NegGram caplet label; susceptible urinary tract infection
usual_adult_dose.dose: Initial adult therapy: 1 g orally four times daily for one or two weeks. Historical reference only; renal impairment requires separate label adjustment and current Philippine instructions must be verified [[NALI]]

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to nalidixic acid or related compounds; age under three months; porphyria; history of convulsive disorders; concomitant melphalan or related alkylating chemotherapy; lactation (historical US label) [[NALI]]

serious: CNS reactions including convulsions, tendon injury, and phototoxicity are label warnings [[NALI]]

monitoring: If treatment exceeds two weeks, periodically assess blood counts and kidney and liver function (historical US label) [[NALI]]

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Calcium/magnesium/aluminum antacids; sucralfate; iron; zinc multivitamins; specified buffered didanosine products
key_interactions.action: Separate by two hours before or after nalidixic acid (historical label) [[NALI]]
